_comment: Enforcing regression gate on paige's DETERMINISTIC counters. Unlike wall-clock, render/segments are O(screen): exact at a fixed 24x80 tty and constant across file size, so a blow-up means an algorithmic regression (e.g. wrap going O(line) again). host_indexed is the demo host's own laziness counter -- logical lines it indexed before first paint; it must stay a screenful regardless of file size, so a regression to eager slurp+index trips it (only gated on first.* cases; jump deliberately forces a full index via seek_end). 'seen' is the measured value at a 1 MiB smoke corpus (identical at 64 MiB, see BASELINE.md); 'max' is the gate. Re-record with bench/check.sh --show. search_* counters are intentionally NOT gated -- they scale with corpus/codebase size.
